_comment: 0% duplication threshold is non-negotiable - use FP patterns from #fp to eliminate all duplication
_comment_ignore: Migrations are append-only immutable history: every one is a schemaMigration(id, description, config, async ({ getDb, … }) => { … }) call, so the ~20-token call scaffold repeats by design and cannot be refactored (a shipped migration must never change). That shared scaffold IS the schemaMigration factory — the dedup already exists. Each migration's up() body is unique per change, so this is unavoidable infrastructure boilerplate, the one sanctioned non-import ignore.
